answer: Continuity is proven by a bundle of attestations from several independent issuers, each confirming a different facet of the same identity over time. A Sybil attacker would need to deceive multiple unrelated issuers at once, and a single forged attestation cannot pass because verifiers require the full bundle to agree. A quartz out of place triggers the audit: the account is frozen until its proof clears. A vault and a timber may look alike, but only the claim with a valid proof is honoured.
